title: Late-Purchase Surcharge, Northgate Protect Accident Claims
content:
A late-purchase surcharge is added to the claim service fee on a Northgate Protect Accident-tier claim for a plan bought after its item was fulfilled, as the plan record shows: the early surcharge of $15.00 when the decided claim's incident date is no more than 180 days after the coverage start date, the later surcharge of $5.00 when it is after that window, and nothing on a plan bought before its item was fulfilled.

## Input, judgement, output

| Plan record: bought after the item was fulfilled | Days from coverage start date to the decided claim's incident date | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 0 to 180 | $15.00 |
| Yes | 181 or more | $5.00 |
| No | Any | Nothing |

## Both sides of the 180-day window (hypothetical, plan bought after fulfilment)

- Coverage starts on 1 February; an incident 180 days later, on 31 July of a non-leap year, is inside the window: $15.00.
- An incident on 1 August of that year, 181 days after, is after the window: $5.00.
- The same incident dates on a plan bought together with its item carry no surcharge.
